crossRefs.note: You shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are on it. You shall bring in the lamp stand, and light…
You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.
Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne…

parallels.note: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn…
Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lamp stand, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: He lit the lamps before Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
translations.bsb: and set up the lamps before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.
translations.kjv: And he lighted the lamps before the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.asv: And he lighted the lamps before Jehovah; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
